name: RFC/WFM Import and Reconciliation
scope: immutable import runs and source observations
WFM accepted-source proposal handoff to LLD-05
SR-link and Customer reconciliation candidate generation
not_owned_here: WFM/Task identity/current source projection/operational plan/Objective consequences -> LLD-05
transaction_boundaries: Workbook discovery, stabilization, security validation, parsing, normalization, logical fingerprinting and proposal calculation occur outside authoritative domain mutation transactions.
Unpublished validating-run staging may be written in bounded technical transactions but is excluded from source authority, review and domain queries until atomic publication of the complete run.

Every accepted reconciliation proposal uses exactly one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork and one command receipt; LLD-02/03/05 owner services participate in that same UnitOfWork and never commit independently.

Run finalization and source-checkpoint update are atomic; equal-chronology correction may replace fingerprint/run at the same chronology only through authorized recovery, while older-source recovery never moves chronology backward.
Recovery authorization/rejection/defer decisions are append-only review authority; they never themselves mutate RFC/WFM/Task domain state.
failure_modes: unsafe, unstable, inaccessible or malformed workbook candidates fail visibly without silent fallback to an older candidate
partial or interrupted validating runs remain unpublished and cannot establish source presence, replay authority, proposals or checkpoint advancement
identity/header/content ambiguity blocks only the smallest safe scope unless workbook-level integrity makes the complete source inseparable
proposal acceptance fails closed on stale proposal fingerprint, target base-state token, Customer reference generation, RFC hierarchy or Task plan/execution state
recovery-required runs remain closed to ordinary acceptance until an exact current recovery review is authorized, and whole-run rejection is forbidden after accepted proposal mutations
cross-domain nested commit, partial participant mutation and checkpoint/run disagreement are prevented by same-UoW rollback and explicit failure-injection tests
construction_evidence: all required packet directories are populated and the exact packet file set is pinned
RFC and WFM filename/source-profile/header/vocabulary semantics are versioned and deterministic
direct-file discovery and XLSX validation treat workbooks as untrusted local input and reject reparse/path/resource hazards
immutable published source observations are separated from unpublished technical staging and authoritative domain state
logical replay and chronology checkpoints distinguish exact replay, newer-identical source, equal-chronology conflict and older-source recovery
proposal generation and disposition operate at the smallest safe scope and omission has no lifecycle meaning
accepted RFC mutations cross only LLD-03 owner interfaces; accepted WFM/Task mutations are pinned as LLD-05 interfaces without inventing Task schema
Beta 1.0 RFC/WFM domain mutation auto-accept policy is empty; terminal/customer/timeframe/link and competing-source changes require review
recovery review is append-only, stale-bound and cannot reject a whole run after accepted proposal mutations
happy-path, replay, chronology, ambiguity, stale-state, crash, security and partial-participant failure vectors are explicit
design_principle: Every workbook is untrusted immutable source evidence first. Discovery, parsing, fingerprinting, presence recording and proposal generation never become domain mutation; accepted changes cross only bounded owning-domain command interfaces after exact-source, chronology, replay and stale-state checks.
